scope: Historical already-open periods only. No 2026 prospective outcome access.

common_rules.entry_semantics: first available 15m open strictly after signal timestamp; where a test perturbs entry, the perturbation is applied exactly as declared below

rt004_random_signal_placebo.matching: For each actual selected trade, choose a placebo calendar date from the same YYYY-MM and preserve the actual entry UTC quarter-hour. Candidate placebo dates require both entry and +24h exit opens in the canonical raw artifact.
rt004_random_signal_placebo.exclusion: Exclude the actual entry UTC date and the immediately previous/next UTC dates for that event.
rt004_random_signal_placebo.overlap: Reject and redraw a replication if any placebo trade overlaps another placebo trade under the frozen one-active-trade rule.
rt004_random_signal_placebo.interpretation: Diagnostic adversarial evidence only; does not change candidate identity or historical tier.

rt005_time_shift_placebo.method: Shift each selected signal timestamp by the fixed offset, then apply the original strict-after 15m entry and 24h exit rule.
rt005_time_shift_placebo.interpretation: If an offset arm is unavailable because canonical raw coverage is incomplete, report BLOCKED_ARM; never substitute another offset.

rt007_parameter_perturbation.interpretation: Robustness diagnostic only. No variant may replace the frozen rule or receive promotion credit.

rt017_volatility_matched_placebo.volatility_measure: standard deviation of 15m log-close returns over the 24h immediately before entry
rt017_volatility_matched_placebo.matching: Same YYYY-MM and same entry UTC quarter-hour, with control pre-entry volatility within ±20% of the actual event pre-entry volatility; require full pre-window, entry and +24h exit.
rt017_volatility_matched_placebo.exclusion: Exclude actual entry date ±1 UTC day.
rt017_volatility_matched_placebo.fallback: If fewer than 5 matched control dates exist for any event, the volatility-matched test is BLOCKED; do not widen the band.
rt017_volatility_matched_placebo.interpretation: Tests whether ordinary high-volatility states can explain the observed event return. Diagnostic only.

stop_conditions: Any methodology change after Phase B results are computed
